Class ReadOptions

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.ReadOptions
public class ReadOptions extends Object
Options for a single read or a compatibility OperatorInputStream.

Version selection and conditions require service support and apply to every chunk.

All supplied conditions must hold for data to be returned. When a direct read or OperatorInputStream issues a backend read, missing files fail with OpenDALException.Code.NotFound and failed conditions on an existing file fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch. Unsupported version selection or conditions fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported. Presigned read requests validate options and capabilities without executing against storage.

Invalid execution values fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid. Invalid ranges fail with OpenDALException.Code.RangeNotSatisfied.

An Instant outside the Rust core timestamp range fails with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

Optional reference fields default to null.

  • Field Details

    • offset

      public final long offset
      Byte offset to start reading from.

      Defaults to 0L. Negative values fail with OpenDALException.Code.RangeNotSatisfied.

    • length

      public final long length
      Number of bytes to read from offset.

      The default of -1L reads to the end, and 0L selects an empty range. For direct reads and OperatorInputStream with length == 0L, OpenDAL validates options and capabilities, then returns an empty result without accessing storage or evaluating conditions against the file. Presigning a read with this value still goes through request generation.

      Values below -1L or an invalid offset + length range fail with OpenDALException.Code.RangeNotSatisfied.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • version

      public final String version
      Read the given version of the file instead of the current one.

      This selects which stored version the read returns; it is not a condition on the file. A version that does not exist returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithVersion

    • ifMatch

      public final String ifMatch
      Read only when the file has this exact ETag.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and its ETag equals this value. A file with a different ETag returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound. Only concrete ETag values are portable; a wildcard such as "*" has no portable meaning here.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfMatch

    • ifNoneMatch

      public final String ifNoneMatch
      Read only when the file does not have this ETag.

      With a concrete ETag value, the condition succeeds when the file exists with a different ETag. A file whose ETag equals this value returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound. Only concrete ETag values are portable; a wildcard such as "*" has no portable meaning here.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfNoneMatch

    • ifVersionMatch

      public final String ifVersionMatch
      Read only when the file has this exact version.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and its version equals this value. A file with a different version returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound.

      This condition checks the identity of the file selected by version.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfVersionMatch

    • ifVersionNotMatch

      public final String ifVersionNotMatch
      Read only when the file does not have this version.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists with a different version. A file whose version equals this value returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfVersionNotMatch

    • ifModifiedSince

      public final Instant ifModifiedSince
      Read only when the file was modified after this timestamp.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and was modified after this time. A file not modified since this time returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound.

      An Instant outside the Rust core timestamp range fails with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfModifiedSince

    • ifUnmodifiedSince

      public final Instant ifUnmodifiedSince
      Read only when the file was not modified after this timestamp.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and was not modified after this time. A file modified after this time returns OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch; a missing file returns OpenDALException.Code.NotFound.

      An Instant outside the Rust core timestamp range fails with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

      See Also:
      • Capability.readWithIfUnmodifiedSince

    • concurrent

      public final int concurrent
      Maximum number of internal chunk requests executed concurrently.

      Defaults to 1. Values less than or equal to 0, or too large for the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer, fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.

      This setting applies only to chunked reads enabled by chunk. Application transfer and Java thread counts are independent of this setting.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • chunk

      public final long chunk
      Target size of each internal range request in bytes.

      The default of -1L keeps unchunked streaming. Positive values enable chunked reads and must fit the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer. 0L, other negative values, and values that do not fit fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • contentLengthHint

      public final long contentLengthHint
      Known content length of the object.

      Supply the full object length in bytes, regardless of the requested range. The default of -1L means the length is unknown. Use 0L for an empty object. Values below -1L fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.

      OpenDAL uses this hint only to plan reads and can use it to avoid a metadata request. For chunked reads (chunk set), a contentLengthHint no greater than the starting offset can result in no backend read requests. When the hint equals the starting offset, including 0L at the start of a file, OpenDAL may return empty data without checking file existence or evaluating conditions. An incorrect hint can truncate reads or cause errors.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • overrideContentType

      public final String overrideContentType
      Specify the content-type header that should be sent back by the operation.

      This option is only meaningful when used along with presign.

    • overrideCacheControl

      public final String overrideCacheControl
      Specify the cache-control header that should be sent back by the operation.

      This option is only meaningful when used along with presign.

    • overrideContentDisposition

      public final String overrideContentDisposition
      Specify the content-disposition header that should be sent back by the operation.

      This option is only meaningful when used along with presign.

    • limit

      public final long limit
      Return at most this many bytes from the start of the selected range, accepting EOF after a valid starting byte.

      The default of -1L leaves the limit unset. Without a limit, bounded forward ranges require the full requested length. Values below -1L fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.

      On direct whole-buffer reads, 0L validates options and capabilities, then returns an empty result without accessing storage or evaluating conditions against the file. With a positive limit, a nonempty forward selection starting at or beyond EOF fails with OpenDALException.Code.RangeNotSatisfied.

      Setting a limit (limit != -1L) with a positive chunk, with concurrent greater than 1, with OperatorInputStream, or with presigned read requests fails with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.
